svg.title: How a /poteto-mode run moves
svg.desc: A prompt goes to the chat running /poteto-mode. It restates the goal and the smallest change, matches a playbook and copies its steps into the todo list, then understands and designs (how, why, architect, prototype a fork instead of asking). It hands code to poteto-agent delegates or fans out with swarm or arena. Work is verified on the real surface; a failed or inconclusive check loops back to a fresh delegate. Passing work becomes a PR of small ordered commits with a Verification section. The lead chat owns every delegate and pauses only for irreversible writes.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One chat owns the run. Delegates do the typing.
